measurement_git_commit_note: The exact implementation commit is assigned after final explicit staging and recorded by the evidence follow-up commit.

selected_architecture.layout: application-owned normalized n-ary same-axis split tree with exact positive integer weights
selected_architecture.text: safe persistent UTF-8 piece treap over immutable bounded backing with canonical flat oracle
selected_architecture.unicode: extended grapheme cursor/edit boundaries from unicode-segmentation 1.13.3; exact UTF-8 authority; no normalization
selected_architecture.line_endings: exact observed LF/CRLF/mixed and final-terminator facts; CRLF insertion for pure CRLF; otherwise LF
selected_architecture.runtime: prepared validated programs and retained managed values with materialization/restart differential
selected_architecture.terminal: closed SGR mouse/focus events, abstract styled logical frames, acknowledged row differential with full fallback
selected_architecture.filesystem: selected-filesystem 2 with Linux pinned-root confinement, mode preservation, recursive bounded search, conflict and reconciliation
selected_architecture.jobs: one foreground owner and one capacity-one worker; application-owned pending identity; no retry
selected_architecture.packaging: one embedded target-derived checked application; artifact override only for conformance

serious_rejected_alternatives: binary split layout: equivalent structures require extra canonical rotations and greater edge-drop depth
flat immutable text: middle edit and growing insert copy unchanged text
persistent chunk vector: identical prototype was slower and lacks logarithmic aggregate traversal
mutable gap buffer: fastest end-insert prototype but cannot share immutable undo/two-view roots without a second owner
classic original/append piece table: edit-piece growth introduces a separate compaction policy
transient flat builder: improves construction only and leaves middle splice, undo roots, and viewport aggregates
adjacent package resource plus embedded fallback: dual package lookup authority
general async runtime or worker pool: no consumer beyond one bounded job
bytecode/JIT tier: current correctness and differential evidence does not yet justify a second executor

semantic_dogfood.change: open-content status changed from tab opened to ordinary tab opened
three rendering helpers cut over to bulk text/scalar and sequence repetition operations
viewport cell fitting cut over to bounded text_cell_prefix_boundary

known_limits_and_reversal_gates: 10,000 mixed events take 27.865 seconds and miss the 10-second campaign ambition
1,000 growing inserts take 3.883 seconds and miss the 2-second ambition
unoptimized duplicate layout replay took 977.90 seconds; one exact-digest replay remains the debug oracle
process startup, first logical frame, first terminal flush, and 1 MiB/16 MiB file stage percentiles were not directly instrumented
persistent unsaved editor recovery, regex, syntax highlighting, clipboard, file watch, binary files, plugins, and cross-platform support are absent
trust: one trusted local operator and OS account, first-party Rust, validated package, one selected root, optional selected semantic project; inputs and outcomes are hostile bounded data
provider_telemetry: unavailable; no token, cache-class, or monetary inference
